en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a formal spa square with a large rectangular open area framed by low plant beds and benches where many people are sitting and strolling. Mature trees and wooded hills form the backdrop. On the right side is a long, low modernist building with large windows, likely shops or spa facilities. The scene is busy with visitors in period clothing. At the bottom center the caption reads "Bad Elster – Badeplatz."
